description: Governor Office - North - Western Province - The report of the Oneman Investigation Commission Extended one month period from 10.03.2023 to 09.04.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an investigation period for a commission looking into potential offenses by a Mayor. The content involves judicial/law enforcement matters, specifically the appointment of a retired judicial officer to conduct an investigation under the Municipal Councils Ordinance. It falls under Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with legal proceedings, investigations, and law enforcement procedures rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
